scenes.prompt: Rows of leather-bound ledgers on stone shelves, one pulled out and open on a lectern, cold light from a high window. oil painting, visible brushwork, muted ochre and grey-green palette, soft overcast northern light, painterly, no text, no lettering
lines: There are four copies of the record. The Almoners are not careless.

lines: Three of them agree with each other.
The fourth is the one the Kiln was shown.

scenes.prompt: A grey-robed woman's hands resting flat on a closed ledger, knuckles pale, no face visible. oil painting, visible brushwork, muted ochre and grey-green palette, soft overcast northern light, painterly, no text, no lettering
lines: So it was not an error of copying.
It was done once, carefully, for someone to read.
